# Awesome A2A Servers

> A curated list of Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol servers, clients, libraries and tutorials. People read README.md; agents read list.json, which holds the same entries and is rebuilt from it.

A2A is an open protocol, started by Google, that lets agents built on different frameworks find each other and work together. Each entry here links to an open-source project that implements or uses it, with marks for its language, scope and whether it is official.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how to read the list, add an entry, and run the check
- [README.md](README.md): the list for people, by section and category
- [list.json](list.json): every entry with its name, link, description, section, category, languages and scope

## Sections

- [Official Resources](README.md#official-resources): the protocol's own repository and specification
- [Clients](README.md#clients): command-line and web clients for A2A servers
- [Tutorials & Learning Resources](README.md#tutorials--learning-resources): guides, samples and courses
- [Server Implementations](README.md#server-implementations): A2A servers in 18 categories, from browser automation to multi-agent systems
- [Frameworks](README.md#frameworks): agent frameworks with A2A support
- [Utilities](README.md#utilities): libraries in Python, JavaScript, Go, Java, .NET and Rust, and tools
- [Documentation](README.md#documentation): documentation and translations
- [Legend](README.md#legend): what each mark means

## Contributing

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): the entry format and what qualifies
- [tools/build-data.mjs](tools/build-data.mjs): rebuilds list.json from README.md and checks the format

## Protocol

- [A2A on GitHub](https://github.com/a2aproject/A2A): the protocol's repository
- [A2A specification](https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/specification/): the protocol specification
